title: HelperSessionsResult
description: Result of the helper session service's sessions op: every live host session this generation holds. The array is never null — an empty inventory is [], because a decoder distinguishing 'no sessions' from 'no answer' needs the empty case to arrive as one. The distinction is load-bearing beyond tidiness: a coordinator turns an ANSWER that a session is absent into a deletion, and anything else into 'unknown', where nothing is deleted.
